reference_sql:
SELECT l.order_line_id, pr.promo_name
FROM orders o
JOIN order_lines l ON l.order_id = o.order_id
LEFT JOIN promotions pr ON pr.promo_id = l.promo_id
WHERE o.channel = 'web'
  AND o.order_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-03-08 00:00:00' AND o.order_ts < TIMESTAMP '2025-03-09 00:00:00'
alternatives: SELECT l.order_line_id, pr.promo_name FROM order_lines l JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = l.order_id LEFT JOIN promotions pr ON pr.promo_id = l.promo_id WHERE o.channel = 'web' AND CAST(o.order_ts AS DATE) = DATE '2025-03-08'

SELECT l.order_line_id, pr.promo_name FROM promotions pr RIGHT JOIN order_lines l ON l.promo_id = pr.promo_id JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = l.order_id WHERE o.channel = 'web' AND o.order_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-03-08 00:00:00' AND o.order_ts < TIMESTAMP '2025-03-09 00:00:00'

other_way.sql: SELECT l.order_line_id, pr.promo_name FROM promotions pr RIGHT JOIN order_lines l ON l.promo_id = pr.promo_id JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = l.order_id WHERE o.channel = 'web' AND o.order_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-03-08 00:00:00' AND o.order_ts < TIMESTAMP '2025-03-09 00:00:00'
other_way.tradeoff: RIGHT JOIN from promotions keeps every line as well, but the lines then sit in the middle of the chain instead of at its start.
